Header.description: RADAR Object Header â€“ Standard OSD-RAO-Vx.y

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this RADAR Object is or is intended to be located.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this RADAR Object is or is intended to be located.

RADARObjectID.description: Unique identifier of this RADAR Object.

RADARObjectTime.description: Time this RADAR Object was produced.

RADARObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this RADAR Object is located.

BasicRADARObjectCount.description: Number of Basic RADAR Objects contained in this RADAR Object.

BasicRADARObjects.description: Set of Basic RADAR Objects contained in this RADAR Object.

BasicRADARObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Basic RADAR Object is located within the containing RADAR Object. If absent, the Space/Time of the containing object applies.

BRObjectIDOrBRObject.description: Either the ID of a Basic RADAR Object or the Basic RADAR Object itself.

SubRADARObjectCount.description: Number of child RADAR Objects contained in this RADAR Object.

SubRADARObjects.description: Set of child RADAR Objects contained in this RADAR Object.

SubRADARObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this child RADAR Object is located within the containing RADAR Object. If absent, the Space/Time of the containing object applies.

SubRObjectIDOrSubRObject.description: Either the ID of a child RADAR Object or the child RADAR Object itself.

BRObjectOrRObject.description: A mixed array of Basic RADAR Objects and child RADAR Objects contained in this RADAR Object.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this RADAR Object in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the RADAR Object (plain text, max 2048 characters).
